note: Quests (D-054). File order = story order. Shape documented in scripts/rules/quest_rules.gd. Flags are set by dialogue nodes ("flag"), boss deaths (boss_<enemy_id>_dead), kill counters (kills_<enemy_id>), and by the host for reach_m / have objectives. Act 1 is playable (finale: Collection Day, D-102); Act 2 chapter 1 (South of the Tracks, D-103) is playable, the rest of Act 2 and Acts 3-4 are story outline (locked_note). All names and numbers are placeholders: edit freely.

mq1_static.name: Five Years of Static
mq1_static.summary: Five years underground, and every radio channel plays the same static, in the same rhythm. Bonk says that's not fallout. That's somebody. Find out who is still transmitting in a dead town.

objectives.text: Ask Bonk what the plan is (and whether there is a step two)
Follow the static to the biggest antenna in town: the Archway over I-80
Find whoever is living inside the Archway
Get Evan to tell you about the machine under the escalator

mq2_collector.name: The Collector
mq2_collector.summary: The machine in the Archway answered the bomb with one word: ACKNOWLEDGED. It is still sending. Shutting it off takes a Suit's keycard, and the Suits only come up to the surface for one thing: people. Someone in town has been keeping count of who they take.

objectives.text: Ask Evan how the machine can be shut off
Go to the Chillers in the student union at UNK
Ask Meekachu who the Suits have taken
Ask Meekachu about the one who does the taking

mq3_detention.name: Detention
mq3_detention.summary: The Suits don't do their own collecting. They gave a badge, a rifle and a quota to Hunter Conner, and Hunter turned Kearney High into his holding pen. He carries an eagle keycard. The last person he took might still be inside.

objectives.text: Get inside Kearney High School (main doors, east side)
Find the people Hunter is holding (front office, north hall)
Confront Hunter Conner in the gym
Put Hunter Conner down
Take the eagle keycard off his body

mq4_acknowledged.name: Acknowledged
mq4_acknowledged.summary: You have a Suit's keycard. Evan has sat on top of that machine for five years like a hen on an egg. Time to find out what it has been saying, and who it has been saying it to.

objectives.text: Bring the eagle keycard to Evan at the Archway
Tell Meekachu what the machine printed
Talk to Gus, the janitor who followed the trucks south

mq4b_collection.name: Collection Day
mq4b_collection.summary: COLLECTION, KEARNEY: 14 DAYS. Hunter used to hand people over at the Cash-Wa docks on West 4th Street. Hunter is dead, the fourteen days are up, and the Suits' truck has come up to find out why nobody is waiting. Gus wants whatever paper that truck carries.

objectives.text: Get to the pickup point: the Cash-Wa warehouse docks on West 4th Street
Take out the truck's escort (6 Retrievers)
Kill the Handler, the Suit who came up with the truck
Take the collection manifest off the Handler
Bring the manifest to Gus at the Chillers' fire

mq5_south.name: Act 2: South of the Tracks
mq5_south.summary: The manifest says DELIVER TO SITE GRANARY, and the route ends at the old Kearney Co-op grain elevator on East 20th Street, by the tracks. Gus has stood on that floor. It opens down.

objectives.text: Meet Gus on the scale house porch at the Kearney Co-op elevator (East 20th St, by the tracks)
Clear the Retriever yard crew (5)
Find the logbook in the scale house
Look down through the drive shed floor
Tell Gus what you saw

mq5b_halvorsen.name: Act 2: Halvorsen's Notebook
mq5b_halvorsen.summary: The floor opens on storm. Halvorsen walked west along the river with a notebook full of storms. Find her trail before the sky goes green again.
mq5b_halvorsen.locked_note: Story outline only, not playable in this build. Planned: follow Halvorsen's trail west along the river, her notebook and the storm schedule, a way to ride the floor down, first look inside Site Granary, learn that the immune are being used to calibrate the storms.

mq6_soup.name: Act 3: S.O.U.P.
mq6_soup.summary: Sustained Operational Something. The storms are a machine, the machine has a schedule, and the schedule has an off switch somewhere under Kearney.
mq6_soup.locked_note: Story outline only. Planned: Halvorsen's notebook, the storm relay network (the Archway is one of several), turning relays off one by one while the Suits hunt the party, Evan's choice.

mq7_clean_shirts.name: Act 4: Clean Shirts
mq7_clean_shirts.summary: They went down on a Tuesday in clean shirts. Go down after them.
mq7_clean_shirts.locked_note: Story outline only. Planned: the descent into the Suits' facility, the people they took, the Director, and the decision about what the world heals into. Bonk was going somewhere nobody else had thought of the whole time.

sq_lighter.name: Before the World Ended
sq_lighter.summary: Bonk borrowed Meekachu's lighter before the bombs fell. Meekachu has not forgotten. Meekachu is not mad. Meekachu is a little mad.

objectives.text: Ask Bonk about Meekachu's lighter
Return the lighter to Meekachu

sq_jerky.name: Forty Jerky and an Apology
sq_jerky.summary: Evan owes Meekachu forty jerky and an apology. Meekachu will settle for some of the jerky and any of the apology.

objectives.text: Get the jerky (and an apology) out of Evan
Deliver 5 of Jerkin's Mystery Jerky to Meekachu

sq_lab.name: Lab Supplies
sq_lab.summary: Patches cooks the Chillers' chemistry with a camping stove and a dream. The science lab at Kearney High still has a proper kit. The science lab at Kearney High also still has faculty.

objectives.text: Find the chem lab kit in Kearney High's science lab (north hall, east end)
Bring the kit to Patches at the Chillers' camp

sq_wren.name: Skyler's Sister
sq_wren.summary: Wren was taken from the Chillers two weeks ago. She is alive, locked in the front office of Kearney High, and she is not leaving while Hunter is still walking the halls.

objectives.text: Kill Hunter Conner so Wren can walk out
Tell Skyler his sister is alive (grow room, Chillers HQ)

sq_hall_pass.name: Hall Pass
sq_hall_pass.summary: Hunter's Hall Monitors run the corridors of Kearney High. Wren has listened to them sprint past her door for two weeks. She would like that to stop.

objectives.text: Kill 8 Hall Monitors

sq_faculty.name: Faculty Meeting
sq_faculty.summary: Two things in Kearney High are worse than the Hall Monitors: whatever is still wearing the Bearcat mascot suit in the auditorium, and Big Darlene, who never stopped serving lunch.

objectives.text: Kill the Bearcat in the auditorium
Kill Big Darlene in the cafeteria

sq_last_call.name: Last Call
sq_last_call.summary: Raiders have walled off the bar blocks on Central Avenue, and anyone who walks onto the bricks comes back lighter or doesn't come back. They answer to Copperhead, who runs fights in the basement of Copperfields and calls the whole street his tab. Somebody should close it out.

objectives.text: Scout the raider barricade on Central Avenue near 21st Street
Thin out the raiders in the downtown bars (12)
Go down into the Pit under Copperfields and kill Copperhead

sq_cart.name: Where's My Damn Cart?
sq_cart.summary: The Bargain King has lost the shopping cart that holds his entire inventory. He is taking it about as well as you would expect.

objectives.text: Find the Bargain King's cart
Take the wheel back to the Bargain King

sq_cones.name: Cone Wars
sq_cones.summary: An intersection on the east side has a king, a throne and a foreign policy. Six of its cones have been taken by a rival collective.

objectives.text: Collect six traffic cones
Pay tribute at the Cone Throne

sq_tp.name: The Great Toilet Paper Heist
sq_tp.summary: The Safety Inspector cannot sign off on a settlement with zero rolls of sanitary tissue. The form will not permit it.

objectives.text: Find three rolls of toilet paper
Hand them to the Safety Inspector

sq_greg.name: Greg's Problem
sq_greg.summary: Greg is looking for something. He cannot describe it, name it, or say what it does, but he will know it when he sees it.

objectives.text: Find the thing Greg can't remember
Give it to Greg

sq_door.name: The Wrong Door
sq_door.summary: There was a door standing in a field with nothing attached to it. You opened it. Something was on the ground on the other side.

objectives.text: Keep what came through with you
Ask the Collector about the door

sq_cap37.name: The 37th Bottle Cap
sq_cap37.summary: Winifred says the local bottler only ever made thirty-six cap designs. She also says she has seen a thirty-seventh.

objectives.text: Find the 37th cap
Take it back to Winifred

sq_parking.name: Unpaid Parking
sq_parking.summary: A sedan downtown is buried under four thousand parking tickets. The most recent one was written last Tuesday.

objectives.text: Show the tickets to the Sheriff of Nothing

sq_chair.name: The Lawn Chair Tournament
sq_chair.summary: Buzz holds the regional title in an endurance event with two rules: there are two chairs, and nobody stands up.

objectives.text: Win the sitting contest
Collect your title from Buzz

sq_donut.name: The Last Donut
sq_donut.summary: There is one donut left in Kearney, it is preserved behind glass, and at least three people believe it is theirs.

objectives.text: Decide who gets the donut

sq_corn.name: The Corn Debate
sq_corn.summary: Two people in this county disagree about what kind of corn is growing in Experimental Plot 4, and the Sheriff of Nothing needs it settled before somebody gets hurt.

objectives.text: Ask the campfire stranger about the corn
Ask the Collector about the corn
Give the Sheriff of Nothing a ruling

sq_pool.name: The Unbeatable Pool Player
sq_pool.summary: Fast Eddie has never lost a game of pool. Not before the bomb, not after. He would like you to know that.

objectives.text: Beat Fast Eddie at pool
Watch him rack and call him on it

sq_mann.name: The Missing Mannequin
sq_mann.summary: Winifred keeps a ledger of the mannequins in a shop past the bars. The number in the ledger has gone up.

objectives.text: Find the shop out past the bars
Tell Winifred what you saw
